# Bottled Marbles

> Bottled Marbles is a calm marble sorting puzzle for iOS, made by ipe Studio. Move the marbles until every bottle holds a single color. It has 300 levels, with hints when you get stuck. There is no account and no server.

The app is not released yet: the App Store listing is coming soon, and this site has no store link or price. Pages below are the public site; the site is available in 12 languages (English, Korean, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, French, German, Indonesian, Thai, Vietnamese, Turkish).

## Game facts

- Name: Bottled Marbles (구슬병)
- Genre: puzzle (sorting)
- Platform: iOS
- Levels: 300
- Hints are available when a player is stuck
- No account, no server: progress is kept on the device
